decision: Replays start as a dry run: succeed / fail / skipped counts before anything happens
why: Replaying blind can double-apply or fail again silently.
value: Operators know the outcome before they commit.

decision: Every event keeps its idempotency key through DLQ and replay
why: Consumers must be able to ignore duplicates no matter how many times an event is replayed.
value: Replays are safe by construction; duplicates show up as 'skipped'.

decision: Transforms run as pure functions in a sandbox with a time budget
why: Fixing data during an incident must not become a new way to break production.
alternative: Edit messages by hand in the queue.
value: Transforms are reviewable, versioned with the replay and cannot call out.

decision: The transform preview is validated against the canonical schema before replay
why: A transform that produces invalid events just moves the problem downstream.
value: Bad transforms are caught before they touch consumers.
